reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 15 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Kings (revenge).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 86 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 205 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Sacramento finished the worst homestand in franchise history (0-7), and Zach LaVine and Domantas Sabonis had a visible on-court exchange. Doug Christie is in the final secured year of his contract, with replacements already being floated. The Lakers, without Austin Reaves, are stung by losing to Utah, and Luka Doncic called his own game 'unacceptable'. The angle leans towards the Lakers.
